credits: The author generated this model with Tripo from original concept art. No third-party art is in it.

steps.tool: Tripo Studio web UI (studio.tripo3d.ai), Image to 3D
steps.settings: HD Model, AI model H3.1 - Best Quality, Generate in Parts off, 8K Texture off
Quad topology, Smart Mesh on, polygon count 9000
steps.result: 9,558 quad faces, 8,960 vertices (17,896 triangles in the GLB)

steps.settings: Rigging type Humanoid, skeleton preset Mixamo
steps.result: 65 joints with the mixamorig: prefix, one skin, no animations

steps.settings: Format GLB, texture resolution 4k, Export Skeleton on

steps.tool: Blender 5.2.2 LTS through the Blender MCP (blender-mcp add-on, port 9876)
actions: Imported assets/skaters/nia/raw/nia-tripo.glb with the glTF importer.
Removed the Tripo empties (Node_0, node_0, RootNode) and kept the world transform of the armature.
Scaled the armature and the mesh by 1.7384 (0.978 m to 1.700 m) and applied the location, the rotation, and the scale.
Checked that the wheels touch z = 0 and that the model faces -Y in Blender (+Z in glTF).
Kept the Mixamo rig (65 mixamorig: joints) and the skin weights. The mesh was not decimated, because it had 17,896 triangles.
Resized the textures: base color 4096 to 2048, normal 2048 to 1024, metallic-roughness 2048 PNG to 1024 JPEG. All JPEG, quality 88.
Set the specular tint to white, so that the exporter writes no KHR_materials_specular. KHR_materials_volume and FB_ngon_encoding are not written.
Exported a GLB with Draco (level 6; quantization: position 14, normal 10, texcoord 12, generic 12), no animations.
steps.result: assets/skaters/nia/skater.glb, 2,123,152 bytes, 17,896 triangles, 1 skinned mesh, 65 joints, 1.700 m tall, extensions: KHR_draco_mesh_compression only
local_files_not_in_git: assets/skaters/nia/raw/nia-nodraco.glb (the same export without Draco, 3,732,876 bytes, for Cascadeur)

five_views: assets/skaters/nia/views/ (front, back, left, right, three-quarter), made by e2e/skater-model.spec.js
